# Written by hand before GenReady
User-agent: *
Disallow: /private/

steps.code:
<?php
// The plugin is mounted read-only at /e2e-src/genready. Copy it, so deleting it on the Plugins screen deletes the copy.
$copy = function ( $from, $to ) use ( &$copy ) {
	mkdir( $to, 0777, true );
	foreach ( scandir( $from ) as $name ) {
		if ( '.' === $name || '..' === $name ) {
			continue;
		}
		is_dir( "$from/$name" ) ? $copy( "$from/$name", "$to/$name" ) : copy( "$from/$name", "$to/$name" );
	}
};
$copy( '/e2e-src/genready', '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/genready' );
